events.subtitle: Words Fall Short
events.category: Modern jazz / Living masters / Current-project performance
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Joshua Redman's Words Fall Short on October 20-22, 2026, with 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets each night. The announced quartet is Redman with pianist Paul Cornish, bassist Philip Norris and drummer Nazir Ebo, the core band heard on the 2025 Blue Note album Words Fall Short. The venue frames the engagement around that current album and its theme of the beauty of human imperfection rather than as a retrospective program.

provenance.note: Dates, showtimes, lineup, venue and current-project context verified against Blue Note Tokyo's exact event page. The listening recommendation is the exact Apple Music album page for Words Fall Short.

en.why_it_matters: This clears S because Redman is not simply bringing a famous catalog to Tokyo: he is presenting the working quartet built around Words Fall Short, with Paul Cornish, Philip Norris and Nazir Ebo, a younger band whose identity is already embedded in the record. For Listening Notes the attraction is a major living saxophonist choosing current language over nostalgia, in a room small enough for articulation, time feel and quartet interaction to matter.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Protect a set and build a Tokyo night around it if you are there; the exact current quartet and album-centered context make it substantially stronger than a routine legacy booking, though it does not by itself justify a transpacific trip.

es.why_it_matters: Esto cruza a S porque Redman no llega a Tokio simplemente a administrar un catálogo famoso: presenta el cuarteto de trabajo construido alrededor de Words Fall Short, con Paul Cornish, Philip Norris y Nazir Ebo, una banda joven cuya identidad ya está metida dentro del disco. Para Listening Notes, el atractivo es escuchar a un gran saxofonista vivo escogiendo lenguaje actual en vez de nostalgia, en una sala donde importan la articulación, el pulso y la interacción del cuarteto.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Vale proteger un set y construir una noche de Tokio alrededor de él si estás allá; el cuarteto actual exacto y el contexto centrado en el disco lo hacen mucho más interesante que una contratación rutinaria de legado, aunque por sí solo no justifica cruzar el Pacífico.

events.artist: Alfredo Rodriguez Band featuring Pedrito Martínez
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Alfredo Rodriguez Band featuring Pedrito Martínez on October 12-14, 2026. October 12 has 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM sets; October 13-14 have 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets. Rodriguez appears with Pedrito Martínez, bassist Swaéli Mbappé and drummer Michael Olivera. The venue says the program will draw from Rodriguez's 2026 album ¡Take Cover!, the Rodriguez-Martínez duo album Duologue and earlier repertoire.

provenance.note: Dates, differentiated set times, lineup, venue, current-album and Duologue repertoire context, and web reservation path verified against Blue Note Tokyo's exact event page. The listening recommendation is the exact Apple Music album page for ¡Take Cover!.

en.why_it_matters: The S case is the Rodriguez-Martínez pairing, not celebrity billing. Rodriguez brings a highly physical Cuban piano language shaped by classical technique and modern jazz, while Martínez comes from Afro-Cuban folkloric percussion and vocal tradition; Blue Note Tokyo is explicitly programming both their current material and the Duologue connection. That puts rhythm, touch and real-time dialogue at the center rather than treating Latin color as decoration.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Protect a set if you are in Tokyo: the piano-percussion relationship between Rodriguez and Martínez is strong enough to make the night a destination inside Kanto, but the three-night run and broader touring context keep it below S+ and below transpacific-trip status on its own.

es.why_it_matters: El argumento para S es la pareja Rodriguez-Martínez, no el simple peso de los nombres. Rodriguez trae un lenguaje de piano cubano muy físico, atravesado por técnica clásica y jazz moderno, mientras Martínez viene de la percusión y la tradición vocal afrocubana; Blue Note Tokyo programa explícitamente material actual y la conexión de Duologue. Eso pone el ritmo, el toque y el diálogo en tiempo real al centro, en vez de usar lo latino como decoración.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Vale proteger un set si estás en Tokio: la relación piano-percusión entre Rodriguez y Martínez tiene suficiente identidad para volver la noche un destino dentro de Kanto, pero las tres noches y el contexto de gira más amplio la mantienen por debajo de S+ y, por sí sola, por debajo de justificar cruzar el Pacífico.
